header.name: 李伟 · 金管局调查组

messages.text: 陈女士您好，我是新加坡金融管理局（MAS）调查组的李伟。刚才电话里说过，您的银行户口涉及一宗洗钱案件，案件编号 2231。
我一辈子都没有做过犯法的事，怎么会这样？
我们相信您是无辜的。为了保护您的存款，您必须马上把钱转到金管局的安全账户，调查结束后全数退还。

安全账户：Harbour Bank 123-45678-9
户名：Lee Wei Investigation Acct
金额：S$8,000
备注：case 2231
这是机密调查，不要告诉您的孩子或银行职员，否则会影响调查，您也可能被起诉。
今天下午 5 点前一定要完成，不然您所有的户口都会被冻结。
Hi Raj! Kelly from TaskStar here 😊 Great job finishing your first 3 tasks, your S$36 commission is already in your account.
You're now eligible for the Gold task set: 20 tasks at 15% commission each!
To unlock it, top up S$450 to your task wallet. It's refundable, you get it back with your commission after the set.
Transfer to our finance colleague: Orchid Trust Bank 556-208417-390, name Ahmad Danial. Please send me the receipt 🙏
Gold slots are limited today, many members are waiting.

document.title: Tenancy Agreement
to_lines: Premises: Blk 214 Bishan Street 23, #09-221 (3-room HDB flat, fully furnished)
body: 1. Term. Two (2) years from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2028.
2. Rent. S$3,200 per month, payable in advance on the 1st day of each month by bank transfer to the Landlord's account below.

3. Security deposit. One (1) month's rent, S$3,200, payable within seven (7) days of signing. It is refundable without interest within fourteen (14) days after the end of the tenancy, less any sums owed under this agreement.
4. Utilities and conservancy. The Tenant pays for electricity, water, gas and internet. The Landlord pays the Town Council service and conservancy charges.
5. Minor repairs. The Tenant bears the cost of minor repairs up to S$150 per item. Major repairs and the replacement of appliances are borne by the Landlord.
6. Diplomatic clause. Either party may end the tenancy after the first twelve (12) months by giving two (2) months' written notice.
7. Inventory. The inventory list, signed by both parties at the handover viewing on 6 October 2026, forms part of this agreement.
Signed by both parties at the offices of Bayfront Homes Realty on 8 October 2026.
